description: Hosted memory service that gives a person's AI clients one shared vault over remote Streamable HTTP MCP, with search by meaning or by date window, approved saves, connection status, tiered consolidation and deletion.

notes: OAuth with PKCE and RFC 9728 discovery. Each grant is bound to one OAuth-selected vault with independent memories:read, memories:write and memories:delete scopes.
No API key or Memory Key is entered in the host for MCP connections.

clients: Any MCP client supporting remote Streamable HTTP and OAuth
license: Hosted service, no local package. Terms: https://memoryrouter.ai/terms

notes: initialize against https://mcp.memoryrouter.ai/mcp returned HTTP 200 with serverInfo name MemoryRouter and version 1.1.0 on 2026-10-27.
tools/list on 2026-10-27 returned the ten tool names recorded here, and search is documented as a compatibility alias.
Homepage, MCP setup page, docs and terms returned HTTP 200 on 2026-10-27.
